lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Primary nodes are spaced with regular verticality, forming a repeating grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a series of anchor points where the vertical 'stripes' cross the horizontal axis of the spot pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A subtle horizontal linear feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance upper pixels to shadowed lower pixels, indicating a physical ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt morphological transition in patterning located at the post-cranial boundary, where high-density, small-diameter chaotic spot distribution on the head shifts to lower-density, larger-diameter grid-aligned blobs on the trunk.
